public_source_audit.source: Godin & Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719
observations: The article was published 2026-08-25 and explicitly provides S1 Code as DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 (Code.zip).

The accessible article text states SPLiT combines online Oja subspace estimation with normalized LMS in manifold coordinates and notes that a pseudoinverse or intrinsic-coordinate rewrite could in principle address full-space ill-conditioning if manifold structure were already known.
Direct file-level recovery of S1 Code remained blocked in the available public transport during this invocation; no source-exact S8/S11/S12 claim is made here.
public_source_audit.scope: Public paper inspection only; no external code artifact was executed.

bounded_audit.status: explicit ambient-drift full-space regularized control; non-reproduction
bounded_audit.purpose: Identify whether adaptive low-dimensional tracking retains an advantage over a tuned full-space regularized normalized-LMS readout under genuine ambient subspace drift, and whether that advantage changes with drift rate, observation noise, and ambient dimensionality.

base.target: fixed linear readout of latent coordinates
base.observation_noise: isotropic Gaussian scaled as sigma/sqrt(N), so total ambient noise norm is approximately held fixed as N varies

adaptive_subspace.decoder: normalized LMS in tracked k-dimensional coordinates
adaptive_subspace.reorthonormalization: QR every 20 steps with orthogonal-Procrustes alignment to the previous basis so coordinate sign/rotation changes do not spuriously corrupt the decoder

full_space_control.method: full-space normalized LMS with multiplicative L2-like weight decay
full_space_control.hyperparameter_selection: eta and decay chosen on four separate tuning seeds at medium drift / sigma=0.1

other_controls: frozen initial k-dimensional basis + same normalized LMS
oracle current ambient basis + same normalized LMS
design.important_qc: A naive QR reorthonormalization without basis-coordinate alignment produced spurious decoder errors. Procrustes alignment removed this artifact; all reported results use the corrected aligned basis.

results.paired_bootstrap_summary: For Oja-minus-full MSE, 10,000-resample paired bootstrap 95% intervals were below zero in all 12 drift/noise cells. Example intervals: fast sigma=0.1 mean -2.25697e-4, CI [-2.41311e-4,-2.13330e-4]; medium sigma=0.1 mean -1.72190e-4, CI [-1.77423e-4,-1.67172e-4]; slow sigma=0.1 mean -1.06119e-4, CI [-1.08504e-4,-1.03567e-4].

ambient_dimension_sweep.condition: medium drift, sigma=0.1, k=3, eight separate evaluation seeds

bounded_audit.interpretation: In this bounded synthetic task, adaptive low-dimensional tracking stays close to the oracle current subspace and beats a separately tuned full-space regularized normalized-LMS readout across all tested drift/noise conditions. The relative advantage grows as ambient dimension N increases while intrinsic dimension k=3 and total observation-noise norm are held approximately fixed, consistent with a conditioning/sample-efficiency advantage from rejecting high-dimensional nuisance directions. This does not establish an Oja-specific advantage: the immediately preceding role-local audit found a generic EW-PCA tracker matched or exceeded Oja under explicit ambient drift. The supported transferable mechanism is adaptive low-dimensional subspace tracking plus intrinsic-coordinate learning, not Oja specifically.
limits: Synthetic linear-latent observation model; not the authors' recurrent network and not a reproduction of S8/S11/S12.
Full-space control is regularized normalized LMS, not FORCE/RLS or a pseudoinverse implementation.
Oja and full-space hyperparameters were tuned on separate synthetic seeds but not exhaustively matched for compute or all regimes.
Noise scaling is a deliberate fixed-total-nuisance design and should not be generalized to other observation models.
Do not use these numeric effect sizes outside this bounded control.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Under genuine ambient subspace drift with low intrinsic dimension, adaptive subspace tracking plus intrinsic-coordinate learning can materially outperform a tuned full-space regularized normalized-LMS readout, especially as ambient dimension grows relative to intrinsic dimension.
candidate_update.qualification: Generic adaptive PCA previously matched/exceeded Oja, and this run did not test full RLS/pseudoinverse or source-exact SPLiT code.

exact_next_action: Retry read-only S1 Code recovery and inspect source-exact S8/S11/S12 semantics. If still blocked, add a true full-space RLS/pseudoinverse or equivalently strong regularized least-squares control under the same ambient-drift grid, and compare Oja and generic EW-PCA/PAST side-by-side across N/k ratio and sample budget to map the regime where low-dimensional tracking provides a conditioning or sample-efficiency advantage rather than an algorithm-specific artifact.
